name: See-NeRF
definition: A unified sensor-physics grounded NeRF framework for sharp HDR novel view synthesis from single-exposure blurry LDR images and corresponding events. It models raw HDR scene rays hitting sensor pixels as in the physical world to bridge sensor-physics mismatches.
summary: See-NeRF is a sensor-physics grounded NeRF framework that generates sharp HDR novel views from blurry LDR images and event data by explicitly modeling RGB and event sensor physics.
